title: Giants GM on WR Malik Nabers: 'Still think he'll be fine Week 1'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants GM on WR Malik Nabers: 'Still think he'll be fine Week 1'
sources.description: High expectations for Nabers leave the Giants eager to return their No. 1 receiver. But his integral nature to their season plans also dictate a degree of caution ensuring he doesn't rush back too soon.
